repeatability* Support the definition and execution of go-to-market strategies for Grid Consulting and cybersecurity services within Digital Grid* Represent Siemens Energy in customer meetings, executive briefings, conferences, and industry events* Support internal enablement sessions and trainings for sales and regional stakeholdersWhat You Bring* University degree in Electrical
